stances_toward.note: Israel rejects the Court's jurisdiction: the warrants for Netanyahu and Gallant (21 Nov 2024) stand, the Appeals Chamber in April 2025 sent Israel's jurisdictional challenge back to the Pre-Trial Chamber without suspending them and in October 2025 rejected Israel's bid to cancel them; Germany, Poland and Hungary (until its change of government) have signalled that the warrant would not stop a visit. Rival, not adversary: Israel contests the body and does not seek its end. Bond - grievance.

relations_to.summary: State Party to the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court: bound to execute ICC warrants on its territory. The 2024 Putin visit is the test case (see the action rows). The accession year is from background knowledge, not from a fetched source: verify against the ICC state-party list before publication.

relations_to.summary: Left the Rome Statute with effect from 17 Mar 2019 under Duterte, but the Court kept jurisdiction over crimes committed while a member (1 Nov 2011 - 16 Mar 2019); in 2025 Malacanang said Marcos was open to rejoining but that no serious discussion had begun.

relations_to.summary: Rodrigo Duterte was arrested in March 2025 and transferred to the ICC; Pre-Trial Chamber I confirmed all three counts of crimes against humanity (murder and attempted murder, war on drugs, 1 Nov 2011 - 16 Mar 2019) on 23 Apr 2026 a day after the Appeals Chamber upheld jurisdiction; Trial Chamber III set the trial for 30 Nov 2026, subject to a fitness assessment. Interim release was refused at both levels in 2025.
